source_documents.title: NGHE autonomous construction unstructured test text

source_units.text: The NGHE site deployment, the 72 h 38,000 m3 target, and the conditions of 25% cost reduction, 30% schedule reduction, zero personnel accidents, and 0 carbon emissions were presented.
The maintenance team installed BSS_T, ESS_T, and SCS and stockpiled battery packs, and the site supervisor and the ICCC confirmed the RTDD latency and HSM authentication.
DMSS and ASPCS created the terrain data, the ICCC and AI_ICP reflected it in the BIM/digital twin model, and the remote supervisor approved the Level 3 start.
The 19 units of U-EEX, U-EDT, U-EDB, and U-ERC equipment were offloaded sequentially and then simultaneously performed authentication and calibration and reported the ready status.
AI_ICP allocated the excavation points, quotas, and optimal routes to the unloading area, and the equipment started preparing for excavation, hauling, grading, and compaction.
When the 2 h operation indicators came within the normal range, the remote supervisor approved the transition to Level 4 full autonomy mode.
At the 6th hour of operation, an output of about 580 m3 per hour was maintained, and the night noise condition of 65 dB or less and operator shift changes were managed.
After U-EEX Unit 1 SoC reached 15%, Eco Mode, return to BSS_T, battery replacement within 5 min, a 15 min swap cycle, and prevention of 2 or more units leaving simultaneously were performed.
At the 23 h and 24 h points, automatic performance reports were generated, and the cumulative earthwork volume, zero accidents, 0 carbon emissions, and operating rate were recorded.
The AI_ICP PHM module detected the hydraulic system anomaly sign of U-EDT Unit 7, and the maintenance team replaced the hydraulic module within 1 h.
The onboard system applied the OTA route optimization patch in a rolling manner, the output approached about 600 m3, and U-ERC performed compaction work.
On the morning of D+2, dense fog brought visibility to 200 m or less and the sensor confidence score dropped, so AI_ICP proposed a downgrade from Level 4 to Level 3.
The U-EEX Unit 3 HSM detected the forged command packet, and the security system blocked the external public network and switched to the internal closed security network.
When the fog cleared and visibility of 1 km or more and the normal recovery of sensor confidence were confirmed, the remote supervisor approved the return to Level 4.
When the heavy rain forecast came in on the night of D+2, AI_ICP proposed securing maximum construction volume, completing battery swaps preemptively, and designating safe evacuation positions.
The U-EEX Unit 2 LiDAR and camera lens were covered 50% or more, and it detected the maintenance worker approach, expanded the Keep-out Zone 2 times, and then came to a full stop.
When the heavy rain intensified, the remote supervisor issued a forced work stop command, and all equipment switched to Level 1 emergency stop mode and waited at the safe evacuation positions.
After the heavy rain ended, DMSS and ASPCS performed terrain rescan and reference point re-correction, 2 subsidence zones were identified, and AI_ICP recalculated the bypass routes.
After the site safety inspection, construction resumed in Level 3, and after about 30 min of normal operation was confirmed, the Level 4 transition was approved again.

Following the moisture content changes after the heavy rain, the compaction pressure and number of passes were automatically adjusted, and at the 72 h completion point the cumulative earthwork volume became about 38,200 m3.

The final report recorded zero personnel accidents, net-zero carbon emissions, an operating rate of 95.2%, availability of 99.1%, construction error of +-3 cm, and route-following precision of +-4.2 cm.

scenarios.label: NGHE 72 h autonomous construction full scenario

flows.label: Infrastructure installation -> RTDD/HSM confirmation -> terrain model construction
Work allocation -> excavation -> hauling -> grading -> compaction
Operation data review -> Level 4 approval -> AI_ICP autonomous adjustment
SoC 15% -> Eco Mode -> return to BSS_T -> battery replacement -> return to work
PHM anomaly detection -> non-core route reassignment -> hydraulic module replacement
OTA patch reception -> rolling update -> output improvement
Fog occurrence -> confidence drop -> Level 3 downgrade -> speed limit
Forged packet detection -> external network blocking -> switch to internal security network -> security log
Visibility recovery -> Level 4 return approval -> speed limit lifted
Heavy rain forecast -> advance swap -> safe evacuation position designation
Sensor covering -> automatic cleaning -> pedestrian detection -> Keep-out Zone expansion -> full stop
Heavy rain intensifies -> forced work stop -> Level 1 -> safe evacuation waiting
Heavy rain ends -> rescan -> reference point re-correction -> subsidence identification -> route recalculation
Safety inspection -> Level 3 resumption -> return to work area -> 30 min confirmation -> return to Level 4
Compaction adjustment -> 72 h completion -> final report

validation_issues.message: In the source text, whether the operation mode just before the heavy rain was Level 4 or Level 3 can vary with context, so from_situation is kept as a candidate.

assumptions: Exhaustive is an extraction scope that preserves every sentence cue as a slot candidate, and merging of duplicate candidates may be needed in the implementation stage.
The canonical owner of relations between slots is slot_relations.
